title: Certify degree-eight vanishing in an Artinian quotient

source.citation: Rank 2 aCM and Ulrich bundles on Fano and Calabi--Yau double coverings of P3, arXiv:2510.26850

translation.notes: The five quartic generators are restated directly. Degree-eight vanishing is certified by enumerating standard monomials of the computed initial ideal.
